This '''Imperial major''' was affected to the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] during the [[Thrawn campaign]] and served under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. He led the strike team which landed on [[Myrkr]] to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. His [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] eventually caught him in the [[Great Northern Forest]]. When capturing Luke, he noted the latter's deformities, and mentioned they've got a fully qualified medic to fix Luke up.

The major was later killed when Skywalker and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] were [[Rescue on Myrkr|rescued]] by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in [[Hyllyard City]].
